body_json.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's claim that police kill innocent Black people without consequences closely echoes [T4-002635](#T4-002635), which frames each incident as "Another cop. Another black man. Another killing of innocent person," and [T4-003024](#T4-003024), which asks why a Black child "gunned down by police" is "not criminal" — both sharing the new post's framing of innocence plus unaccountability. [T4-009367](#T4-009367) overlaps on the impunity theme ("Yet there's no justice") but broadens the target to police generally committing crimes rather than specifically lethal force against innocent Black people. [T4-003352](#T4-003352) and [T4-003320](#T4-003320) share the general topic of police misconduct but differ in emphasis, attacking police competence/authority and public imitation of police racism respectively, without the new post's specific innocence-and-consequences framing. All are endorsements of the critique rather than rebuttals or reporting, though none supplies evidence for the underlying factual claim.
